handlers.name: Approve Credit Usage Dialog
handlers.script: (function() { let candidates = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')).filter(el => { let t = (el.textContent || '').trim(); return (t.includes('Approve, do not ask again') || t === 'Approve') && t.length < 50; }); candidates.sort((a, b) => a.children.length - b.children.length); if (candidates.length > 0) { let best = candidates.find(el => (el.textContent || '').includes('do not ask again')) || candidates[0]; best.click(); return true; } return false; })();

handlers.name: Dismiss Low Credits Warning Banner
handlers.script: (function() { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')); const banner = all.find(el => (el.textContent || '').includes('running low on Google Flow credits') && el.children.length > 0); if (banner) { const btns = Array.from(banner.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]')); if (btns.length > 0) { const closeBtn = btns.find(b => { const text = (b.textContent || '').trim(); const aria = (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').toLowerCase(); return text === '✕' || text === 'X' || text === 'x' || aria.includes('close') || aria.includes('dismiss'); }) || btns[btns.length - 1]; if (closeBtn) { closeBtn.click(); return true; } } } return false; })()

handlers.name: Open Video 3-Dots Menu
handlers.script: (function() { const videos = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('video')); if (videos.length === 0) return false; const lastVideo = videos[videos.length - 1]; let el = lastVideo; for (let depth = 0; depth < 6 && el && el !== document.body; depth++) { ['pointerover', 'pointerenter', 'mouseover', 'mouseenter', 'mousemove'].forEach(evName => { try { el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent(evName, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); if (window.PointerEvent) { el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(evName, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window, pointerType: 'mouse' })); } } catch(e) {} }); el = el.parentElement; } el = lastVideo.parentElement; for (let depth = 0; depth < 6 && el && el !== document.body; depth++) { const buttons = Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button, [role="button"]')); const moreBtn = buttons.find(b => { const l = (b.getAttribute('aria-label') || b.getAttribute('title') || '').toLowerCase(); return l.includes('more') || l.includes('option'); }) || (buttons.length >= 2 ? buttons[buttons.length - 1] : null); if (moreBtn) { moreBtn.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); moreBtn.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window })); moreBtn.click(); return true; } el = el.parentElement; } return false; })()
